**Sources**

1. **Near‑total abortion bans (Jan 2023)** – Guttmacher Institute, “Six Months Post‑Roe, 24 US States Have Banned Abortion or Are Likely to Do So: A Roundup”, lists the 12 states and includes Alabama, Arkansas, Idaho, Kentucky, Louisiana, Mississippi, Missouri, Oklahoma, South Dakota, Tennessee, Texas, West Virginia.

The ten states with the highest poverty percentages in the 50‑state sample are: Mississippi 14.3%, Louisiana 14.1%, New Mexico 13.7%, West Virginia 12.0%, Kentucky 11.9%, Arkansas 11.5%, Alabama 11.3%, Oklahoma 11.3%, Texas 10.5%, South Carolina 10.1%.
